root.title: OnMaruBE parallel test and benchmark adoption
root.goal: Replace serial verify execution with safe module-aware parallel CI and measurable release evidence.
root.background: Existing root issue #255 records the serial bottleneck and is reused.
root.scope: Baseline capture, catalog ownership, CI fan-out/fan-in, toolkit caller adoption, release evidence validation.
root.out_of_scope: Production promotion and automatic business-code modifications.
success_criteria: Actual workflow run proves parallel modules and evidence.
root.architecture_summary: OnMaruBE owns config and caller workflow; toolkit is called at a pinned release.
definition_of_done: Release benchmark gate verifies immutable identity.

issues.title: ci: 현재 baseline과 OnMaruBE module catalog를 확정한다
issues.objective: Serial baseline evidence and consumer-owned catalog are produced before workflow changes.
issues.context: #255 requires before/after proof and safe affected selection.
issues.scope: Three baseline runs, module/resource inventory, catalog config and fixtures.
issues.implementation_notes: Measure current develop without changing verify semantics.
issues.parallel_notes: Can run while toolkit T1/T2 are implemented.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog covers all current Gradle and AI test scopes.
issues.verification_method: Fixture validation and recorded workflow links.

issues.title: ci: verify를 fan-out/fan-in 병렬 test 구조로 전환한다
issues.objective: Existing serial verify becomes isolated hygiene, Gradle, Python, contract, and integration jobs while preserving required verify.
issues.context: The current check name is protected by ruleset.
issues.scope: Job split, cache setup, concurrency, final verify fan-in, workflow tests.
issues.implementation_notes: Do not change deployment workflow or release permissions.
issues.parallel_notes: Serial after baseline to preserve S1 measurement.
acceptance_criteria: verify remains the final required status and fails on required child failure.
issues.verification_method: Workflow fixture tests and Actions run inspection.

issues.title: ci: toolkit module matrix caller와 affected fallback을 연동한다
issues.objective: OnMaruBE invokes toolkit at a pinned release and passes the consumer catalog without runtime import.
issues.context: Depends on toolkit T3 and consumer catalog B0.
issues.scope: Caller workflow, permissions, artifact download, path/full-suite fallback fixtures.
issues.implementation_notes: Use read-only PR permissions; only summary/comment job may write PR comments.
issues.parallel_notes: Cross-repository blocked by toolkit T3, recorded in issue text.
acceptance_criteria: docs-only and unknown diff behavior is safe.
Catalog and reverse dependency changes produce correct matrix evidence.
issues.verification_method: Consumer workflow fixture and test PR run.

issues.title: ci: develop/nightly/release benchmark evidence와 gate를 연동한다
issues.objective: Branch-specific modes, GitHub Artifact/Release asset baselines, S1-S5 reports, and release hold behavior are verified.
issues.context: Depends on consumer parallel execution and toolkit comparison/remediation contracts.
issues.scope: develop/nightly/release caller modes, evidence retention, release smoke/digest link, report publication.
issues.implementation_notes: Five comparable release runs are required before a regression hold.
issues.parallel_notes: Final consumer integration; wait for toolkit T4 for remediation output.
acceptance_criteria: Release asset manifest and 15% hold policy are demonstrated.
issues.verification_method: Actions run, release fixture, and report review.
